basis: the root is a live region whose role follows the tone: role="alert" for assertive news, role="status" for polite, no role when live="off" (Alert.vue).

harness.because: alert.e2e.ts pins the live region's announcement behaviour — evidence beyond the alert row's browserless obligations, kept as the component's own proof

interaction.basis: a dismissible alert carries one operable part of its own — the close control.

exceptions.because: alert.e2e.ts dismisses by pointer only — the close control's keyboard contract is unproven in browser
no unit-tier state pin yet — the dismissed state is browser-witnessed in alert.e2e.ts and unpinned in the unit tier
